build_VitHDRIHead: build a VitHDRIHead decode head with custom deconv and conv layer configurations for HDRI output
create_make_final_layer: create a final layer with flatten and linear layers using SiLU activation for feature projection
create_make_conv_layers: create convolutional layers with instance normalization and SiLU activation for spatial feature downsampling
create_make_deconv_layers: create deconvolutional upsample layers with instance normalization and SiLU activation for feature upsampling
run_forward_VitHDRIHead: run the forward pass of VitHDRIHead to transform inputs into HDRI-shaped output tensors
